title: 🧹 Remove unused STATIC_PARTNERS export
body:
🎯 **What:** Deleted `src/data/partners.ts` which contained an unused `STATIC_PARTNERS` export, and removed its outdated reference in a python tooling script (`.agents/tools/audit_sanity.py`).
💡 **Why:** Removing completely unused files reduces technical debt and cognitive load for future maintainers.
✅ **Verification:** Ran full test suite to ensure no components actually relied on the static data.
✨ **Result:** Cleaner source tree with no dead data exports.
